title: Width after truncation
statement: Let $n$ and $w$ be nonnegative integers, and let $C$ be a depth circuit on $n$ coordinates. Form a circuit by retaining exactly those first-layer terms of $C$ whose widths are at most $w$, and pulling the later circuit layers back to the retained gates. The resulting circuit has width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a depth circuit on $n$ coordinates
